text: Another important concept for all promotions is the **Seq Num** (Sequence Number). This is used to configure the order that promotions are applied. Higher value promotions should generally have lower sequence numbers so they are run before lower value promotions. Unless configured otherwise most promotions are only applied to order item quantities that have not already been used by another promotion. If you configure a lower value promotion to run first (lower sequence number) it will use up order item quantities so they can't be used by higher value promotions.
